output:
To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

@everyone charity stream is saturday nov 21, 10am to 10pm, for the Linden Community Pantry. i'm posting this early on purpose. last year i put it up the thursday before, half of you didn't even know it was happening, and we only got $212 😭

goal this year is $600.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry and nothing gets taken off. every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food through their wholesale partner. they're serving around 340 families a week and their shelves are the lowest they've seen going into thanksgiving, so this one actually matters.

Rook is matching the first $100 that comes in, so the first $100 counts double.

incentives (the mods made these, blame them):
$100 = i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 = chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 = one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 = i vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry

the hair dye is the real reason to donate, i'm not gonna pretend otherwise.

the stream itself: first half is community lobbies where anyone can join and i'll drop the code. second half chat votes on the game every 2 hours. no repeat maps, larry, i promise.

if you can't give, genuinely no stress. even $3 helps, but nobody's keeping score. no card? you can still help. canned and boxed food goes in the blue bin by the pantry's side door, saturdays 9 to 1, so you can drop stuff off before the stream starts. showing up, hanging out in chat, and sending this to a friend all count too.

and if charity streams just aren't your thing, that's fair, you don't have to give to hang out. but there's food for a lot of families and my hair on the line, so come through.
